briefing: This is {PATRON}, and this station needs a lane cleared.
Pirates hold the way out of {HERE}, and every hull I send back limps home empty.
Fly it, fight through, and dock on the far side, and I will pay you well for it.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} wants a word about the lane out of {WORLD}.

lane.arrive: Fly to {TARGET} through the pirates on the lane, and dock for {PAY}
lane.success: You broke the lane and docked at {TARGET}, and earned {PAY}
lane.fail: The lane held, {TARGET} stayed out of reach, and the {PAY} was lost

rumour.far: They say {PATRON} at {WORLD} pays well for anyone who can break the pirate lane.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the lane still needs clearing, and the pay still stands.

dossier.news: Word around {WORLD} says {PATRON} still needs a pilot to break the pirate lane.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, she agreed to break the pirate lane out of {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the lane out of {WORLD} was open again.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the lane out of {WORLD} was still shut.

lane.success: On day {DAY}, she broke the lane and docked at {WORLD}.
lane.failed: On day {DAY}, the lane beat her before she reached {WORLD}.

dossier.title: Clear the Lane
